day_shape: Two same-day State Department sanctions packages target Iranian shipping (19 vessels) and Hamas networks, CENTCOM chief Cooper testifies to House Armed Services, IDF strikes 25+ Hezbollah targets in south Lebanon, and Khamenei's office pushes a heavy population-growth messaging cycle.

threads.label: US sanctions and CENTCOM posture hearing
threads.summary: The State Department announced sanctions on Iranian currency exchanges, front companies and 19 vessels under the 'Economic Fury' campaign, alongside a separate package targeting Hamas support networks. CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper testified to the House Armed Services Committee, with CENTCOM posts stating Iran 'cannot reconstitute for years' and that 88 commercial vessels had been redirected.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah drones
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck more than 25 Hezbollah targets in south Lebanon and issued renewed evacuation warnings for Tyre, Nabatieh and surrounding villages, while a Hezbollah drone struck Israeli territory injuring two and another was intercepted. Defa Press and IRIB claimed Hezbollah conducted 14 missile and drone operations in 24 hours, targeted two Iron Dome positions and killed a Maglan unit soldier.

threads.label: Iran nuclear talks and called-off strike
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump said he called off a major attack on Iran planned for Tuesday after Gulf allies signalled a deal was possible, and Iran's new proposal demands reparations, US troop withdrawal and an end to the Lebanon war. Jerusalem Post cited NYT analysis that Iran could fire hundreds of missiles daily if war resumes, while Deputy FM Gharibabadi accused Washington of presenting threat as peace.

threads.label: Khamenei population growth messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB published multiple coordinated posts of the Supreme Leader's reply to population activists, stating that the continuation of Iran's power has a direct relationship with population growth. Jerusalem Post reported the regime is staging mass weddings as couples register for 'sacrificial service'.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Qeshm incidents
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported explosions on Iran's Qeshm Island with air defences activated and drone sightings preceding the blasts. Iran International reported Tehran is floating 'protection fees' for subsea fibre-optic cables crossing the Strait of Hormuz, while IRIB previewed coverage of the strait's closure and reopening.

threads.label: Gaza operations and reconstruction
threads.summary: The IDF said it dismantled a Hamas weapons storage site and rocket launch shaft in northern Gaza and killed an October 7 attacker who crossed the Yellow Line, while Jerusalem Post cited a captured document showing Hamas trained recruits during the ceasefire. The Board of Peace warned of a funding gap in Trump's $70 billion Gaza rebuilding plan.

threads.label: Iraq, Russia-China axis and Iran outreach
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Iraq is distancing itself from Iranian-backed militias and condemned drone attacks on Saudi Arabia under US pressure, while Defa Press and IRIB covered Putin's arrival in Beijing for talks with Xi. IRIB said the Deputy Foreign Minister met China's ambassador and framed Qalibaf's appointment as Tehran's special representative for China as a commitment to Beijing.
